messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "avoid talking for about 5 minutes after dosing"
set: ["avoid talking for about 5 minutes after dosing", "take about 30 minutes after the same meal each day", "avoid eating or drinking for at least 15 minutes afterward", "take 30 minutes after dinner", "about a week of once daily dosing", "about 4 hours after taking", "take at least 30 minutes after aspirin", "continued oral dosing for 1 to 2 days after completion of chemotherapy", "learn about foods to eat or avoid", "once-daily dosing", "dosing schedule occurs after dose has been settled", "continue smoking for about 1 week after starting the medicine", "about 4 days: acid-lowering effect reaches maximum with once-daily dosing", "dosing should continue for at least 6 weeks", "continue your regular dosing schedule after skipping the missed dose", "drink the mixture slowly, over 5 to 10 minutes in all"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
